column1: # THE OPERAND WALK'S ADJUDICATION TABLE.  srcwalk_worklist.py joins every
# (isa, mnemonic, register) that LOSES a published source register when the
# Capstone operand walk is deleted -- the exec171 price, 540,798 encodings --
# to these rows, and REFUSES on any losing signature that matches none, on any
# that matches two, and on any row here that matches nothing.
# THE ONE QUESTION EVERY ROW ANSWERS: does the ENCODING NAME the register?
# REAL-OPERAND      the encoding names it as an ordinary operand and QEMU does
#                   not state that read.  Remedy: a statement at QEMU's
#                   decoder.  A wire change; owes R13.
# REAL-VOCAB-GAP    the encoding names it and QEMU reads it, but the tracer
#                   has no declared regfile row to name it WITH.  Remedy: a
# REAL-QEMU-ELIDES  QEMU's chosen lowering drops a register the encoding
#                   names.  R15 verbatim: that is NEVER grounds to remove it
# SUPERSET          the encoding does NOT name it, or a standing ruling says
#                   the read does not exist.  The walk over-named it and the
#                   wire is RIGHT to drop it.  Needs the ruling AND a
#                   whole-population arm -- plausibility is not a verdict.
# OPEN              no verdict.  MUST carry the question and the method that
#                   would answer it; the instrument refuses an OPEN row with
#                   no question mark in its note.
# only banked pair in which arm B is the walk-deleted tree.  Counts in the
# notes are reg-INSTANCES over that pair unless they say encodings.

column7: note

column6: exec177/X86_ARM.txt + X86_ARM_ROWS.tsv (srcwalk_x86_arm.py, whole losing population, 224,227 encodings / 468,922 register instances, TWO references required to agree)
column7: 267,887 instances, the single largest bucket in the whole price, and the arm ANSWERS it: 173,703 NAMES, 1,438 NOT-NAMED, 92,746 abstained. Of every row two independent references decoded, 99.18% name the register in the operand text, so R7.3/R15 bind and the remedy is a statement at QEMU's decoder. THE NOT-NAMED RESIDUE IS THE IMPLICIT-OPERAND CLASS, NOT A SUPERSET: AT&T text prints architectural operands and not implicit ones, so an instruction whose register is fixed by the opcode reads NOT-NAMED however real the read is. The 1,438 are exactly that list -- xsetbv/xgetbv (ECX selects the XCR), invlpga, encls/enclu/enclv, vmrun/vmload/vmsave/skinit/clzero (implicit RAX), vmfunc, cpuid, sysexit -- every one an SDM-fixed operand, which makes them REAL by the architecture and merely unwitnessable by disassembly. ABSTAINS ARE COUNTED APART AND EXPLAINED, not discounted: the bulk is `lock`-prefixed forms whose destination is a register, which both references refuse while QEMU decodes them; then the AVX2 gather family objdump renders (bad); then MPX bnd*, where the two references disagree. None of them is a row the arm scored.

QUESTION: which reading applies per mnemonic? `xtn2 v1.16b, v0.8h` writes the upper half and PRESERVES the lower, which is R7.1's shape exactly and would make it SUPERSET; `usra v1.8b, v0.8b, #8` ACCUMULATES into Vd, which is #228's shape and would make it REAL.
